paragraphs: While the field of artificial intelligence and machine learning has been steadily progressing since the latter half of the 20th century, the release of ChatGPT in 2022 brought Large Language Models (LLMs) and generative AI models into the mainstream. Infamously, spending and investment in AI continues to reach new records, with an estimated 1.5 trillion USD spent in 2025. In terms of market size, the AI market sits below Internet of Things and Cloud Computing today at 539 billion USD with a CAGR of 30.6%.
